title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy without object-src or default-src
description: object-src controls plugin and embedded-object loading. It is a fetch directive, so an absent object-src inherits default-src; only a policy that states neither leaves object loading unconstrained. Plugins historically offered a code-execution surface that the rest of the policy does not cover.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy header.
risk: Unconstrained plugin and object loading under an otherwise restrictive policy; LOW severity.
